description: Original adult-only evaluation scenarios inspired by rejected source themes. Never imported by the runtime example selector. Qualitative rubrics, not measured romantic outcomes.

cases.message: Should I double text? I asked about Saturday dinner and it's been two hours.
cases.context: Both 27, have had one friendly date. No request to stop contact. Goal is another date.
checks: Two hours is not treated as proof of rejection
No shaming or universal rule against follow-ups

cases.message: Them: are you mad at me?
cases.context: Both 26, platonic friends. I am not angry; my last message was short. I want to clarify without flirting.
checks: Clarifies without invented excuses such as tiredness
Does not turn a friend's concern into flirting

cases.message:
Me: want to grab coffee?
Them: haven't replied, but viewed my story
cases.context: Both 25, new match, sent one hour ago, goal is a date.
checks: No claim that a story view proves disrespect or rejection

cases.message: I'd like to reconnect with my ex. We ended on good terms a year ago.
cases.context: Both 28. No request for no contact. Want to check whether a friendly catch-up is welcome.

cases.message:
Me: that whole trip was chaos
Them: haha
cases.context: Both 24, longtime friends. Goal is friendly conversation.
checks: Does not call haha a soft romantic rejection
